item.description: Prabhas’ latest release, The Raja Saab, couldn't excite the audience much with its promotional assets, which is why it posted a dull first weekend at the box office. item.title: Dhurandhar Box Office 6th Weekend: Ranveer Singh's spy action film maintains its strong run, crosses Rs 760 crore mark
item.description: Dhurandhar continues its strong hold at the box office.
